dispersion.label_zh: 选股有效 — 高离散度

stance.en: Outlook is two-sided: futures price about two hikes; hawkish and easing inputs are roughly balanced (1 vs 2). A hotter-than-expected inflation print and easing inputs are pulling against each other.
stance.zh: 前景双向：期货定价约两次加息；鹰派与宽松因素大体制衡（1对2）。 高于预期的通胀数据与宽松因素相互制衡。
